However, the requestor (Sarah Chen, Enterprise Account Executive) has no approval authority under the credit policy. The limit requires **approval by Elena Novak (Director of Finance) and concurrence by Michael Torres (VP Sales)** per CREDIT-POLICY-2026 sections 3 and 4.
